dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped and two 'C' shaped structures are visible on the posterior dorsal-lateral region. These exhibit high-contrast, jagged, light-colored perimeters that define the boundaries. The pixel intensity transitions sharply from the dark exterior base to the light filament-like edge, although the interior centers remain primarily dark, matching the base coat intensity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density. Localized clusters of solid, high-intensity white pixels lacking internal gradients are restricted to the lower ventral-lateral margin and the region immediately posterior to the head.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent posterior macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary chain of centroids from four smaller structures along the mid-dorsal ridge forms a slightly curved longitudinal line segments.

other_distinctive_markers: The subject exhibits a continuous, complex reticulated or 'crackle' texture where light-colored filigreed lines intersect to form a network across the entire dorsal-lateral surface.
